title: Crash Test 1959 Chevrolet Bel Air VS. 2009 Chevrolet Malibu (Frontal Offset) IIHS 50th Anniversary
summary: An IIHS crash test pitting a 1959 Chevrolet Bel Air against a 2009 Malibu in a frontal offset collision for the institute's 50th anniversary. The old car's occupant space collapses while the modern car's protects its driver.
why: Commenters cite it as stark evidence that modern cars are far safer than older ones, countering nostalgia for 'built like they used to'.

quote.text: This 2009 vs. 1959 offset crash shows how much things have changed
